header.title: About IQRA
header.subtitle: The first freeware open-source Islamic knowledge quiz app with competitive challenges
header.welcome: (Masha Allah!) Welcome to IQRA. Test your knowledge of Islam through learning or challenges.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.charity:
or This is an ongoing charity for the sake of Allah ﷻ, The Entirely Generous.
Thus, all apps by IQRA team of Rafique and Joy are freeware, and open source.
mission.aim: So, through gaming and social learning, IQRA aims to make Islamic knowledge accessible, engaging, and interactive for Muslims around the world.

players.heading: Celebrating Our Players' Contributions!
players.intro: IQRA belongs not only to its creators, but also to the players who make it better. Every correction, constructive suggestion, and improvement identified by our players can make IQRA's Islamic knowledge, data, and user interface more accurate and useful for everyone.
players.totalLabel: Total Rewards Given by the IQRA Team
players.presentBody: Except for Joy Ahmed who is not resident in India, every one else will be presented their respective total rewards during the Kattoo Yamani (KY) Family Meet 2026.
players.feedback: Have you spotted an error or found a way to improve IQRA? Your feedback matters! Send suggestions by WhatsApp to <wa>Rafique</wa> at +91 7558845528. Help us make IQRA better, one thoughtful contribution at a time. May Allah <sym>ﷻ</sym> reward everyone who contributes sincerely to beneficial Islamic learning. Ameen.

dhanish-ali.label: Our First Celebrated Contributor
dhanish-ali.intro: With sincere appreciation, we acknowledge Dhanish Ali for identifying and suggesting five corrections to IQRA. All five suggestions were accepted and implemented by the IQRA coding team.

feroza-mi.label: Our Second Celebrated Contributor
feroza-mi.intro: With sincere appreciation, we acknowledge Feroza MI for identifying and suggesting two corrections to the answer options in IQRA's quizzes. Both suggestions were accepted and implemented by the IQRA coding team.

joy-ahmed.label: Our Third Celebrated Contributor
joy-ahmed.intro: With sincere appreciation, we acknowledge Joy Ahmed for six contributions to IQRA's code and design, which made the app cleaner, more mobile-friendly and easier to use.

riaz-ahamed.label: Our Fourth Celebrated Contributor
riaz-ahamed.intro: With sincere appreciation, we acknowledge Riaz Ahmed Bobby for four suggestions to IQRA's coding and AI, which made coding easier, cheaper, and enjoyable.

openSource.heading: Open Source
openSource.body: IQRA is completely open-source and free to use. We welcome contributions from developers, Arabic linguists, Quran scholars, and anyone passionate about making Islamic knowledge more accessible.

technology.heading: Technology
technology.intro: IQRA is built using modern web technologies:

items.ts: For type safety and better developer experience
items.neon: Serverless Postgres for quiz results, leaderboard, profiles and challenges

ack.heading: Acknowledgments
ack.intro: All praise and thanks are due to Allah <sym>ﷻ</sym>, The Entirely Merciful, The Entirely Generous. IQRA is a labor of love, made possible through the blessings of Allah and the contributions of many, Ameen, Summa Ameen.
ack.concept: Concept, Design & Demo Version: By Mohamed Essa Rafique, whose vision and dedication brought IQRA to life, Alhamdulillah. May Allah ﷻ reward Joy Ahmed (joy_ahmed_007@yahoo.com, joy@zettabyteincorp.com · GitHub @joyahmed) for guiding and mentoring Rafique in this noble endeavor.
ack.vercel: Alpha & Beta Versions, Scale-up, Maintenance: Powered by Vercel and their innovative v0 platform. The seamless deployment and scaling of IQRA owe much to Vercel’s robust infrastructure.
ack.xai: AI-Powered Debugging & Code Optimization: Special thanks to xAI and their AI assistant, Grok, for tirelessly assisting in debugging, optimizing, and enhancing the codebase of both IQRA and KALAM over the past month. Grok’s precision and insights have been instrumental in ensuring a robust and reliable application, Alhamdulillah.
ack.deepseek: Data Coding & Content Curation: Deep gratitude to DeepSeek for their invaluable assistance in structuring data and curating Islamic content, ensuring IQRA’s knowledge base is accurate and accessible, Alhamdulillah.
ack.claude: Debugging & Refactoring: Sincere thanks also go to Claude AI for their meticulous assistance in removing the auth and debugging code, ensuring IQRA’s knowledge base is accessible, to those without email.
ack.gemini: Content Creation: Heartfelt thanks to Gemini for their contributions to crafting engaging and meaningful content for IQRA, enhancing the learning experience for users worldwide, Alhamdulillah.
ack.meta: Community & Contributors: Immense gratitude to Meta all our future open-source contributors, Quran scholars, Arabic linguists, and community members who would provide feedback, questions, and support to make IQRA a global platform for Islamic learning. Shout out to our prospective members who would join our yet to start Groups and Channels in WhatsApp, and Community pages in Fb and other Meta platforms. May Allah ﷻ accept their efforts.
